column5: SceneObject slots 27-2E 35 37 (frames, play, stopAndRedraw(Dc), tick incl. the Fighter's and the Opponent's, stop, getTimerId, isRunning), AnimationVtbl playOnce, animation_set_strip
the WinG shell: WinMain, app_init, AppWndProc (create: on_create and the 50 ms timer 1; destroy, activate, 0x40b hello / 0x40c ready), message loop

XilindroScene: its handler (the GetTickCount beat, clock and end ticks; the keys and latches; the fighter's blows, the opponent's approach and attack, the KO and the clock end, WM_DESTROY and 0x40a), create (MCI, WaveMix, the waves), createScreen
Backdrop/GridBackdrop (one WinG bitmap), XilindroBackdrop's create (5-px grid, no walls), the occupancy grid and its queries
DIB loading, copies and the row blitters (1000 is NOITE's byte-identical 32-bit segment)

the two fighters' own methods: the opponent's creation, FighterVtbl startTimer/walk, OpponentVtbl walk (the wall and stand-off clamps), the opponent's attack choice (srand(time) + rand), the blow and pain wave pairs

XilindroGame: ctor/dtor, GameVtbl 01-06 (createPlayer: the fighter; panel, status bar, init scene, onCreate: the fighter's timer, the opponent, banner and energy bar), game_init, game_take_exit, the conditions
game_handle_message (GameVtbl 00, 3.7 KB: the engine default under the XILINDRO handler, which takes every input) and the Portable pick-up/drop it calls
what is drawn around the fight: the PORRADA banner, the energy bar and its tiles (energy_bar_add_mark), the round clock (draw, blit), the arena band redraw
ObjectList, DrawList, UpdateList (out of line) and message_box_printf's callers' helpers
SceneObject slots 2F-34 36 (moveTo, edges, stopMoving(Dc) and moveTick incl. the Fighter's and the Opponent's, isMoving) and Mover/Fighter/OpponentVtbl placeAt
constructors and destructors of the objects (Fighter, Opponent, Banner, EnergyBar, Player2D/Actor2D/Mover/Animation, XilindroPanel/ControlPanel/Animated3D/Object3D, StatusBar, SceneObject) and frames
SceneObject slots 22-26 (occupy, vacate, attach, canStep incl. the Fighter's and the Opponent's, isStepBlocked) and reattach
the ControlPanel/XilindroPanel and StatusBar methods (ControlPanelVtbl 01-08), draw, tick, inventory icons; created and attached, never shown

SceneObject slots 08-0C getX/getY/getStep, 39 setPosition, 4C unk4E, 4E/4F overlap tests, 50/51 54/55 defaults; the /Od out-of-line accessors (hit box, frame, size); next_object_id, message_box_printf
SceneObject slots 12-1A (dirty rects, overlap, restore background, drawDirtyTo, draw, drawClip(To), erase, slot1F) and the DC hooks
Scene methods (SceneVtbl 01-04 06 08-0C), ctors, scene_create and the destructor, exits
WaveMix (wave_pump is live here: the beat pumps it, and wave_play_loop: murmlut2)
SceneObject slots 00-07 0D-11 38 (Object3D getters/setters, drawBounds), the Object3DVtbl slots, the perspective math

SceneObject slots 1B-21 (redraw, hideAndInvalidate, blitToDc, invalidate incl. the Fighter's and the Opponent's, slot24, hide, show) and 4D redrawOverlapping (the Fighter's and the Opponent's draw each other)
